contract: GET /auth/openid/mobile-redirect. Resolve a valid unexpired native OIDC flow once and redirect to the validated app callback with its authorization result; reject missing, replayed, expired or mismatched mobile state/verifier.

invariants.contract: For an allowlisted native start (S256 code_challenge required), the provider's callback to /auth/openid/mobile-redirect answers 302 to <redirect_uri>?code=<urlencoded code>&state=<urlencoded state>; the app link query equals the provider's code and the state the server generated, and that state is consumed so a second mobile-redirect answers 400 with no Location. A state issued for a second allowlisted URI redirects to that URI, and a new start after a consumed state completes with its own code and state. The HTML redirect body and incidental headers are free.
exceptions: Only audiobookshelf:// URIs are exercised; the allowlist accepts any URI matching the settings endpoint's scheme validation.

invariants.contract: Repeating /auth/openid/mobile-redirect with an already consumed state answers status 400 with no Location and no credentials, and creates no user or session; the app callback that received the first answer still completes into exactly one session because it reads the Express session, not the consumed redirect map entry.
exceptions: The body text is asserted because it is the only client-visible denial besides the status; no client parses it.

invariants.contract: A mobile-redirect request without a state, with an empty state, with a state that was never issued, or with the state of a web flow answers status 400 without a Location or credentials and changes no user or session; an unlisted redirect_uri or absent code_challenge is denied with 400 already at start and no credentials.
exceptions: The 'No redirect URI' branch is unreachable through the API: every map entry is created together with a validated redirect URI.

invariants.contract: The mobile redirect map holds each state for ten minutes (LRU ttl 10*60*1000, ttlAutopurge); a state the server does not hold because it was consumed or aged out answers status 400 with no Location and no credentials.
exceptions: The exact ten-minute boundary is not executable: the TTL is an in-process timer with no API or clock injection, so expiry is asserted through the identical response for a state the server does not hold.
force is not applicable: GET /auth/openid/mobile-redirect has no force, override or refresh mode.
The exact ten-minute expiry boundary is unexecuted (see INV-R003-MOBILE-STATE-TTL-001) because the live route exposes neither the timer nor a clock.
Mapping note: named internal Go tests are assertion leads only; the shared scenarios are the executable oracle.
